question: Does the unchanged coherent-cycle component carrier commit the geometry-selected, viewpoint-aligned PV28 frame 92 to 64 pair and reject both fixed cross-scene controls?

predecessor.single_change: Replace independently maximum-visible query frame 111 with frame 64 selected by joint visible-surface fraction times aligned viewing direction. Keep reference frame, model, support, cycle, affine extent, controls and gates unchanged.

reference_binding.support_surface: One native SAM2 mask from the fixed partial reference bbox.
reference_binding.extent_surface: Fixed partial reference bbox transported independently to each query.
reference_binding.query_truth_isolation: Positive query bbox opens only after transport; negatives receive no exact-target query truth.

proposal.transport: Unchanged full-frame symmetric RoMa, bilateral 0.05 certainty, in-bounds target, 0.013888888888888888 round-trip error, largest 8-connected reference cycle component, ordinary affine fit and bound-extent transport.
proposal.component_tie_break: Maximum area then lowest label; no fallback.
proposal.mask: One native reference and query SAM2 identity-support mask; no selection, morphology or retry.
proposal.query_extent: Transported bbox; query SAM mask is support only.

matcher.absolute_support: Frozen cycle opportunity plus dominant-component majority; global purity remains diagnostic only.

evaluation.negative_authority: Different physical 3RScan reference families cannot contain exact target PV28.

literature_motivation.source: Lu and Du, Raising the Ceiling: Conflict-Free Local Feature Matching with Dynamic View Switching, ECCV 2024
literature_motivation.use: Change the active view relationship to raise matchability rather than tuning matcher thresholds.

forbidden_after_freeze: change score, views, models, mask, cycle, component, affine fit, controls or gates
use query truth or pair outcomes to repair the carrier
retry, replace or remove a failed pair
claim_boundary: This is a one-change consumed-source Development test of a geometry/depth active-view transport-opportunity policy. It is not confirmation, arbitrary sibling rejection, provider independence, raw-camera binding, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, deployment, benefit, reliability or safety.
